task.title: Driving safety check and optional proof of experience
task.brief: Answer the 7 picture-style questions about real driving situations. Pick the safe and correct way each time. This takes about 10 minutes. After that, you may add ONE photo as proof of your experience, but it is optional: for example a driving school or training certificate, or a car you look after (clean engine bay, tyre check). Do not show any faces. Cover your licence number, Aadhaar number, address and phone number before you upload. Do not take the photo while driving.
